scope: extracted production classes; controlled platform seams; not a device run

cases.name: positive_control
logs: %{public}s ime proxy selection waiting for attach reason=positive_control mount=s1/c22/m2
%{public}s ime showTextInput ok field=B-note seq=1 reason=positive_control
%{public}s ime proxy selection set [1,3) reason=attach attempt=0
%{public}s ime selection immediate read [1,3) target=[1,3) reason=attach (not evidence by itself)
%{public}s ime proxy selection terminal=INSTALLED reason=attach_confirmed target=[1,3) mount=s1/c22/m2

cases.name: attach_never_settles
logs: %{public}s ime proxy selection waiting for attach reason=attach_never_settles mount=s1/c22/m2
